title: lupinus polyphyllus var. ammophilus
intro: Lupinus polyphyllus var. ammophilus, commonly known as the Wyoming lupine, is a perennial plant species in the legume family that is native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The Wyoming lupine has been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits, which include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
